sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: An informant who worked both in the Federation and the Empire. Although Alyssa had been extorting both nations for money, once the Empire decided to invade the ruins of a disputed region to pay her off, she suddenly disappeared. Some theorize that she left because she was finally satisfied with everything she had gained, but others speculate that something more life-changing happened to her. The Federation and the Empire offered a reward for anyone who would bring her in, but no one dared take the offer. This incident would leave a nasty mark on the reputation of both nations for many years to come.
